Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
This one could've gone into my other post too, if I'd
thought of it a minute ago...

Body Arsenal superior gives the playing vampire +1 strength
until end of combat. If you play BA superior after declaring
a hand strike (but before that pair of strikes is resolved),
does the +1 strength apply to the damage from that strike?
Or is the amount of damage "locked in" when the strike is
declared, even though its characteristics are not?

(Interestingly, this question never occurred to me over the
years of using Potence strength-enhancers, probably because
all the POT strength bonuses seem to say "play before range
is determined.)

Thanks again.

Josh

unending font of rules uncertainty

Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin wrote:
> Body Arsenal superior gives the playing vampire +1 strength
> until end of combat. If you play BA superior after declaring
> a hand strike (but before that pair of strikes is resolved),
> does the +1 strength apply to the damage from that strike?

Yes. Modifiers can be played (and will be effective) any time
before the strike resolves.
